title: instantSearch() or instantsearch()
body: current global export is `instantsearch`, should we go `instantSearch`?

comments.body: I'll go with the more readable `instantSearch`
For a module name, I prefer all lower case, so `instantsearch`.

> For a module name, I prefer all lower case, so instantsearch.

The module in npm will be named `instantsearch.js` but we have to decide what's the name of the exports in window when loaded with a `<script>` (window.instantsearch or window.instantSearch)
Yes, and I prefer `instantsearch`, like we use `algoliasearch` and not `algoliaSearch`.
:+1: for instantsearch as the module and global name for me
Ok I was for instantSearch but since we already have algoliasearch then we should use instantsearch. Thanks. @pixelastic are you ok?
